title: 第23章 日辣大赛惊碎了三观第24章 正赛开始彩头动妖心
content_zh:
对于黑风山的妖怪体系，莫凡在这几日里也有了一个大概了解。
整个黑风山最大的妖怪便是那日在黑风洞中所见的妖王“黑旋风”了，除此之外便是四名妖将。
每个妖将下方又都有三名妖将亲随以及五名妖丁。
而妖丁下方则又有三名丁目亲随以及五名巡山小妖。
所以总的加在一起，整个黑风山的妖怪多达数百余众！
之前莫凡还觉得有些夸张了，可现在一看，好像一点也不夸张。
没一会儿，整个平顶山上便被众多妖怪围出了一个圈。
“看呐，几位将军来了！！”
也不知道是哪只妖怪吆喝了一嗓子，顿时吸引了众妖的目光。
莫凡也抬头看了过去，却见三道身影凌空而至，很快便来到了最前方。
这三妖正是莫凡在黑风洞中所见的那三位妖将，竟都有御空飞行的本领。
三妖刚一出现，立即便有各自麾下的亲随妖怪出列，将早已准备好的桌椅、酒水、瓜果等摆放好，请三位将军入席。
至于黑子等一众妖丁却是没有那个入席的资格，勉强每个妖丁自带了一张椅子，这才不显得尴尬。
至于如同莫凡这样的小妖便是连一个凳子都是没有的，只能干坐着，要么就是横七竖八的或坐或躺在地上，总之给莫凡的感受就一个字“乱”！
“妖怪果然是妖怪，一点纪律性都没有，完全没法和人族比肩！”
莫凡见状却是摇了摇头，心中多少有几分鄙夷，似乎他忘了自己此刻也是这平顶峰众多妖怪之一。
随着三位妖将的到来，整个平顶峰的气氛顿时被推到了高潮，妖怪们吵吵闹闹的闲聊着，甚至有一些妖怪彼此间还出现了斗殴现象。
对此，各家妖丁皆是笑眯眯的观望着，却也不去拉架，至于小妖们更是不嫌事大，在一旁鼓动起来，恨不得打死一个才好。
三位妖将们此刻也是举杯共饮，颇有几分惬意。
当然，斗殴只是平顶峰上的一个小插曲而已，待得日出时分一切又都平息了下来。

“大王爷爷来了！！”
之前那道声音再度响起，接着众妖纷纷抬头看向苍穹。
莫凡抬头看去，却见一团黑云从天而降，速度极快，刹那间便落于三位妖将的中间。
黑雾散去，显露出了妖王魁梧的身形，同时在其身边还有一大群莺莺燕燕，燕瘦环肥皆有之。
这些女子便是妖王的妖姬了。
莫凡细数了一番，发现这些妖姬竟多达十余数，而且全都已经完全显化出了灵身，只有少部分妖怪的特征显露于外表。
这说明这些个妖姬几乎都是妖丁境界！
莫凡还从里面看到了那只兔妖，此刻对方已经完全显化出了灵身，只有头上还矗立着一对兔耳，身上裹着一层红色薄纱，隐藏于其内的曼妙身姿若隐若现，颇有几分勾人心魂的诱惑。
“日辣了，那兔耳奶奶以前怎么未曾见过？这也太好看了吧！”麻雀喳喳在莫凡身边惊呼。
“是啊，这奶奶长得也忒诱人了些，看得俺下面痒痒！”
狗妖来福也咧了咧嘴，接着便嬉笑道：“这奶奶看样子应该是一只兔妖，俺们队里也有个兔妖，红眼这家伙这下子只怕真的要红眼咯！”
正说着，牛妖大力口中便发出一声惊呼：“狗日的红眼，你敢在俺脑袋上撒尿？”
这么劲爆的话语传出，直接就将莫凡等人的目光给吸引了过去。
见众妖望来，红眼顿时急了，连忙讪笑道：“俺……俺没有……”
“还说没有，都他娘的尿俺鼻子上了！”
大力恼怒，可很快却又一脸石化，咬牙道：“不对，怎么有股子腥臭味？你这家伙究竟干嘛了？！”
“腥臭味？”
“俺来闻闻！！”
content_en:
Mo Fan also had a rough understanding of the monster system in Black Wind Mountain in the past few days.
The biggest monster in the entire Black Wind Mountain is the demon king "Black Whirlwind" seen in the Batu Caves that day, and besides them are the four demon generals.
Below each demon general are three demon generals and five demon dins.
Below the demon Ding, there are three more Chongmu and five little demons patrolling the mountain.
So in total, there are hundreds of monsters in the entire Black Wind Mountain!
Mo Fan thought it was a bit exaggerated before, but now it seems that it is not exaggerated at all.
After a while, the entire Pingding Mountain was surrounded by many monsters.
"Look, some generals are coming!!"
I don’t know which monster shouted, which immediately attracted the attention of all the monsters.
Mo Fan also raised his head and looked over, only to see three figures approaching from the sky, and soon came to the front.
These three demons are exactly the three demon generals that Mo Fan saw in the Black Wind Cave. They all have the ability to fly in the air.
As soon as the three demons appeared, their personal demons immediately came out and arranged the tables, chairs, drinks, fruits, etc. that had been prepared, and invited the three generals to sit down.
As for Heizi and the other demons, they didn't have the qualifications to sit down, so they forced each demon to bring a chair so as not to look embarrassed.
As for a little demon like Mo Fan, he doesn't even have a stool and can only sit, or sit or lie on the ground. In short, Mo Fan feels "chaotic"!
"Youkai are indeed monsters. They have no discipline at all. They can't compete with humans at all!"
When Mo Fan saw this, he shook his head, feeling somewhat disdainful in his heart. It seemed that he had forgotten that he was also one of the many monsters on the top of the mountain.
With the arrival of the three monster generals, the atmosphere in Pingding Peak was suddenly pushed to a climax. The monsters chatted noisily, and some monsters even fought with each other.
In this regard, all the demons of the family watched with smiles, but did not start a fight. As for the little demons, they did not think it was a big deal and started to encourage them, wishing to kill one of them.
The three demon generals were also toasting and drinking together at this moment, which was quite pleasant.
Of course, the fight was just a small episode on the summit, and everything calmed down by sunrise.
"Grandpa Wang is here!!"
The previous voice sounded again, and then all the monsters raised their heads to look at the sky.
Mo Fan looked up and saw a black cloud falling from the sky at an extremely fast speed, landing in the middle of the three demon generals in an instant.
The black mist dissipated, revealing the demon king's burly figure. At the same time, there was a large group of orioles and swallows beside him, including both thin and fat birds.
These women are the witches of the Demon King.
Mo Fan counted them carefully and found that there were more than a dozen of these monsters, and all of them had fully manifested their spiritual bodies, with only a few of the characteristics of monsters showing on the outside.
This shows that these enchantresses are almost all in the realm of enchantress!
Mo Fan also saw the rabbit demon from inside. At this moment, the rabbit demon had completely manifested its spiritual body. Only a pair of rabbit ears were still standing on its head. The body was wrapped in a layer of red gauze. The graceful figure hidden inside was looming, which was quite tempting.
"It's hot, why haven't you seen Grandma Rabbit Ears before? This is so pretty!" the sparrow exclaimed beside Mo Fan.
"Yeah, this grandma looks so alluring, it makes me itchy down there!"
The dog demon Laifu also grinned, and then said with a smile: "This grandma should be a rabbit demon. We also have a rabbit demon in our team. This guy with red eyes may really have red eyes now!"
Just as he was speaking, the bull demon Dali exclaimed: "Gorgeous red eyes, how dare you pee on my head?"
Such powerful words came out and immediately attracted the attention of Mo Fan and others.
Seeing all the demons looking at him, his red eyes suddenly became anxious., sneered quickly and said: "I...I don't..."
"You said no, and you pissed on my fucking nose!"
Dali was angry, but soon his face turned petrified, and he gritted his teeth and said: "No, why is there a fishy smell? What on earth did you do?!"
"Stinky smell?"
"I'm here to smell it!!"
